transcript:
incident-bot: PAGED @oncall-maria · SEV=P1 · Alert: elevated 5xx and timeout spike for tenant ZephyrAnalytics on dedicated tau-pool-7 (gpu-node-42). Link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/INC-3780015432
oncall-maria: acked. taking lead. grabbing pool health and live logs. @sre-kevin please join for live mitigation.
sre-kevin: joining. quick look: node-42 reporting repeated BMC watchdog resets + PCIe AER uncorrected errors. ECC errors rising fast: 310 -> 598 in 12m.
infra-bot: diagnostic snapshot:
```
node: gpu-node-42
pool: tau-pool-7
status: degraded
last_bmc_event: 2026-04-02T14:20:12Z (watchdog reset)
kernel: pcie aerr uncorrected: 6, corrected: 22
gpu_temp: 88C (spikes observed)
pods: 9 active (includes zephyr-prod-* x3)
```
oncall-maria: plan: isolate node-42, start controlled drain, fail traffic for ZephyrAnalytics to tau-pool-fallback, pin model to smaller variant, and cap concurrency to limit tail latency. executing drain command now.
oncall-maria: `rpool cordon gpu-node-42 --reason "BMC+ECC flapping" && rpool drain gpu-node-42 --evict-tenants --grace-period 30s`
infra-bot: cordon accepted. drain in progress. evicting 9 pods, migrating to pool tau-pool-fallback where capacity available. ETA ~90s.
eng-olivia: recommend changing route for ZephyrAnalytics /generate to `redwood/7b-q4f` for memory relief and lower p95. also suggest temporarily setting max_concurrency=4.
solutions-raj: notifying Zephyr SRE and Customer Success now.
zephyr-oncall: we see ~30-40% error rate on /generate, confirmed. Please confirm route switchover approach.
oncall-maria: we'll apply non-disruptive route update (fallback) first, then finish eviction. executing API update.
infra-bot: routing update applied: ZephyrAnalytics /generate -> tau-pool-fallback at 3780015468. Traffic shifting.
zephyr-cs: received. customers reporting reduced errors but latency increased ~200ms p95 for some requests.
eng-olivia: expected — fallback pool uses smaller instances and q4f model. mitigation: enable streaming fallback and reduce max_tokens to 96 for Zephyr until we restore capacity.
oncall-maria: applying token cap and concurrency limit: `api routes update --tenant ZephyrAnalytics --route /generate --set max_tokens=96,max_concurrency=4 --reason "mitigate during drain"`
sre-kevin: migration status: 9 pods moved, 0 pending. Node-42 shows BMC log repeating thermal throttle then watchdog reset. This looks like progressive hardware degradation rather than single transient preempt.
infra-bot: opening vendor support ticket: RMA-2026-9901. Onsite ETA proposed 2026-04-03 08:00 UTC. Marking node-42 for replacement on arrival.
oncall-maria: customer credit: apply goodwill credit for impact window 3780015450-3780015550. Finance informed.
solutions-raj: scheduling post-incident call with Zephyr tomorrow. capturing notes for RCA.
eng-olivia: action item ENG-10021: add early ECC rate alert with 5min rolling slope detection to preemptively migrate tenants before hard failure.
sre-kevin: also noting we should avoid auto-readding node-42 to pool until image quarantine and hardware cleared.
oncall-maria: quick checklist:
- node cordoned and drained (done)
- Zephyr route switched to fallback (done)
- model pinned and caps applied (done)
- vendor RMA opened (done)
- customer notified and credit initiated (pending finance)
- postmortem owners: maria (oncall), kevin (sre), olivia (eng), raj (solutions)
oncall-maria: handing off to infra for RMA coordination and eng for follow-up. staying on-hook for 30m. if any regression, page @oncall-maria.
zephyr-oncall: we are monitoring — error rates stayed low for 10m. will confirm after 30m.
infra-bot: final state snapshot at 3780016120: node-42 quarantined, rpool state: drained, migrating pods: 0, zephyr route: tau-pool-fallback, active incidents: 1 (P1 -> monitoring)
